parse.title: Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays
parse.text:
Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays

Char­ac­ter

Wanderer

Talent Type

Elemental Burst

Category

Combat
Energy Cost Cool­down
60 15s
  • Info
  • Attributes
  • Details
Compresses the atmosphere into a singular vacuum that grinds all troubles away, dealing multiple instances of AoE Anemo DMG. If the character is in the Windfavored state due to the skill "Hanega: Song of the Wind," Windfavored state will end after casting.

Skill DMG

147.2–312.8%×5
Scaling
  • ATK

"Bright be the narrowed gaze of the sky, casting its sight on dreams both past and present, like radiance washing over dust on the winds."

Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays is Wanderer's Elemental Burst.

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This ability's trajectory is snapshotted shortly before the burst's animation ends.
Constellation Effects
  • Constellation Level 2, Niban: Isle Amidst White Waves: "When in the Windfavored state, Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays will see its DMG increased by 4% per point of difference between the max amount of Kuugoryoku Points contrasted with Kuugoryoku's present capacity when using this skill. Through this method, you can increase Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays's DMG by a maximum of 200%."
  • Constellation Level 3, Sanban: Moonflower Kusemai: Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.

Change History[]

Released in Version 3.3
[Edit History]
Version 4.5
  • Fixes an issue whereby Wanderer's Elemental Burst could be unleashed abnormally when his Energy wasn't full in certain situations.

Version 3.6

  • Fixes an issue whereby under certain circumstances, after the Wanderer casts his Elemental Burst, the timing where he can sprint would be abnormal.

Version 3.3

  • Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays was released.
